description: The conflict gate test that expects a code conflict to abort with a fingerprinted approval reaches the real role launcher. On a macOS host that has docker on PATH and no Antigravity session directory, the launcher calls sys.exit(1), and the conflict resolver role only catches Exception, so the SystemExit kills the test and local runs of the suite go red on main. Make the role treat a launcher abort as a failed agent verdict, and keep the unit test from reaching the real launcher.
goal: In flow/conflict_resolver_role.py, the dispatch of the role agent treats a SystemExit raised by the launcher as an agent_failed verdict, the same as any other exception, instead of letting it terminate the process. The test that merges main into a conflicting branch replaces the role dispatch with a stub, so no unit test in the conflict gate module reaches the real container launcher, and it passes on a macOS host with docker on PATH and an empty home directory. The module line budgets in holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json are frozen: that file and the budget check scripts must not be edited, and each touched module must stay within its existing budget.
rationale: A launcher abort is an environment failure, not a reason to kill the flow: the resolver already reports other dispatch failures as an agent_failed verdict, and a unit test must never depend on the host having docker, a home directory session or a particular platform. The fix turns a latent hard exit into a handled verdict and removes the host dependence from the test.
acceptance_criteria: In flow/conflict_resolver_role.py, the role dispatch catches SystemExit as well as Exception around the call that launches the role agent and returns the same agent_failed verdict it returns for an Exception; a test in tests/flow/test_conflict_resolver_role.py makes the dispatch raise SystemExit(1) and asserts the agent_failed verdict and that the exception does not propagate.

In tests/flow/review/test_conflict_gate.py, the test that a code conflict still aborts with a fingerprinted approval replaces the role dispatch with a stub, asserts the stub was called for the code-conflict path, and never reaches the real container launcher.
The gate test passes on a macOS host with docker on PATH, an empty home directory and no HOLON_AGENT_KEY, and still passes on ubuntu.
The SystemExit handling does not swallow KeyboardInterrupt, and an Exception raised by the dispatch still yields the same verdict as before.
holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged, every touched module stays within its budget, and uv run pytest on the changed tests, uv run task lint and uv run task lint-docs pass.
